How it works

  • 🎲Spend 100 tokens to face one random fighter from the whole roster.
  • 🔓Beat them and they join your roster.
  • ↩️Beat someone you already own and your 100 tokens come straight back.
  • 💸Lose and the tokens are gone.
  • 🪙Earn tokens by winning Battle mode — 10 tokens per win.

Match Settings

Set up the rules for this multiplayer match before choosing fighters.

Map

Where this match is fought.

Game Mode

Free-for-All: everyone fights at once and the last fighter standing wins.

Time Limit

Choose how long each multiplayer round can last, or leave it unlimited.

Gravity

Change the jump and fall feel for the whole multiplayer match.

Lives

Give every fighter extra chances — getting knocked out costs a life instead of ending the match. Off means one knockout ends it, like a normal free-for-all.

3 lives

Rounds

Play a series of matches with the same fighters. Every round pays out points — 15 for 1st, 5 for 2nd, 2 for 3rd, none for last — and the top scorer takes the podium once every round is done.

3 rounds

Random Characters

Skip the fighter-select screen entirely — everyone gets handed a random fighter and the match jumps straight to the countdown.

Health Limit

Disable fighters whose maximum health is above the selected limit. This also affects random characters.

Instructions

Goal:

knock your opponent's health to 0, or knock them clean out of the arena.

Controls

  • 🕹️Space/W/↑ jump   A/← left   D/→ right
  • ✨E main ability   Q secondary ability   R special ability
  • 👆On touch devices: use the on-screen arrows, or drag anywhere on the arena to steer your fighter. Tap the E/Q/R buttons for abilities.
  • 🎮Controller support: Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo controllers all work automatically — just plug in (or connect via Bluetooth) and press any button. Move with the left stick, jump with the bottom face button (A / ✕ / B), and the ability bar will relabel itself to show the exact face button for each ability on your controller.
  • ⎋Esc / Menu / Controller Menu opens the quit confirmation. Choose Yes or No.
